passages.text: Then Joshua son of Nun secretly sent two spies from Shittim, saying, “Go, inspect the land, especially Jericho.” So they went and entered the house of a prostitute named Rahab and stayed there.
passages.sermon:
Joshua was the son of Nun.
Joshua was the leader of Israel after Moses.
Joshua sent two men from Shittim.
Joshua sent them secretly.
Joshua told them, “Go. See the land. Look at Jericho.”
The two men went.
They entered the house of a woman named Rahab.
Rahab was a prostitute.
The two men stayed at Rahab’s house.
passages.original: וַיִּשְׁלַ֣ח יְהוֹשֻׁ֣עַ־ בִּן־ נ֠וּן מִֽן־ הַשִּׁטִּ֞ים שְׁנַֽיִם־ אֲנָשִׁ֤ים מְרַגְּלִים֙ חֶ֣רֶשׁ לֵאמֹ֔ר לְכ֛וּ רְא֥וּ אֶת־ הָאָ֖רֶץ וְאֶת־ יְרִיח֑וֹ וַיֵּ֨לְכ֜וּ וַ֠יָּבֹאוּ בֵּית־ אִשָּׁ֥ה זוֹנָ֛ה וּשְׁמָ֥הּ רָחָ֖ב וַיִּשְׁכְּבוּ־ שָֽׁמָּה׃

passages.text: And it was reported to the king of Jericho: “Behold, some men of Israel have come here tonight to spy out the land.”
passages.sermon:
The king of Jericho ruled the city of Jericho.
Someone reported news to the king of Jericho.
The report said, “Look, some men have come here tonight.”
These men are from the people of Israel.
They have come to spy out the land.
passages.original: וַיֵּ֣אָמַ֔ר לְמֶ֥לֶךְ יְרִיח֖וֹ לֵאמֹ֑ר הִנֵּ֣ה אֲ֠נָשִׁים בָּ֣אוּ הֵ֧נָּה הַלַּ֛יְלָה מִבְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לַחְפֹּ֥ר אֶת־ הָאָֽרֶץ׃

passages.text: So the king of Jericho sent to Rahab and said, “Bring out the men who came to you and entered your house, for they have come to spy out the whole land.”
passages.sermon:
The king of Jericho sent messengers to Rahab.
Rahab was a woman who lived in Jericho.
The king gave a command to Rahab.
He said, “Bring out the men who came to you.
These men entered your house.
They have come to spy out the whole land.”
passages.original: וַיִּשְׁלַח֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ יְרִיח֔וֹ אֶל־ רָחָ֖ב לֵאמֹ֑ר ה֠וֹצִיאִי הָאֲנָשִׁ֨ים הַבָּאִ֤ים אֵלַ֙יִךְ֙ אֲשֶׁר־ בָּ֣אוּ לְבֵיתֵ֔ךְ כִּ֛י לַחְפֹּ֥ר אֶת־ כָּל־ הָאָ֖רֶץ בָּֽאוּ׃

passages.text: But the woman had taken the two men and hidden them. So she said, “Yes, the men did come to me, but I did not know where they had come from.
passages.sermon:
Rahab was a woman who lived in Jericho.
Rahab took the two Israelite men.
Rahab hid the two men.
Rahab spoke to the king’s messengers.
Rahab said, “Yes, the men came to me.”
Rahab said, “I did not know where they came from.”
passages.original: וַתִּקַּ֧ח הָֽאִשָּׁ֛ה אֶת־ שְׁנֵ֥י הָאֲנָשִׁ֖ים וַֽתִּצְפְּנ֑וֹ וַתֹּ֣אמֶר׀ כֵּ֗ן בָּ֤אוּ אֵלַי֙ הָֽאֲנָשִׁ֔ים וְלֹ֥א יָדַ֖עְתִּי מֵאַ֥יִן הֵֽמָּה׃

passages.text: At dusk, when the gate was about to close, the men went out, and I do not know which way they went. Pursue them quickly, and you may catch them!”
passages.sermon:
Rahab was a woman in Jericho.
She spoke to the king’s messengers.
It was dusk.
The city gate was about to close.
Rahab said the men went out.
She said, “I do not know which way the men went.”
She told them, “Pursue them quickly.”
She said, “You may catch them.”
passages.original: וַיְהִ֨י הַשַּׁ֜עַר לִסְגּ֗וֹר בַּחֹ֙שֶׁךְ֙ וְהָאֲנָשִׁ֣ים יָצָ֔אוּ לֹ֣א יָדַ֔עְתִּי אָ֥נָה הָלְכ֖וּ הָֽאֲנָשִׁ֑ים רִדְפ֥וּ מַהֵ֛ר אַחֲרֵיהֶ֖ם כִּ֥י תַשִּׂיגֽוּם׃

passages.text: (But Rahab had taken them up to the roof and hidden them among the stalks of flax that she had laid out there.)
passages.sermon:
Rahab was a woman in Jericho.
Rahab took the two Israelite spies up to the roof of her house.
She hid the two men on the roof.
She placed them among stalks of flax.
Rahab had arranged the flax stalks on the roof.
passages.original: וְהִ֖יא הֶעֱלָ֣תַם הַגָּ֑גָה וַֽתִּטְמְנֵם֙ בְּפִשְׁתֵּ֣י הָעֵ֔ץ הָעֲרֻכ֥וֹת לָ֖הּ עַל־ הַגָּֽג׃

passages.text: So the king’s men set out in pursuit of the spies along the road to the fords of the Jordan, and as soon as they had gone out, the gate was shut.
passages.sermon:
The king’s men left the city.
They chased the spies.
They went along the road to the fords of the Jordan River.
The pursuers left the city.
After they went out, people shut the city gate.
passages.original: וְהָאֲנָשִׁ֗ים רָדְפ֤וּ אַֽחֲרֵיהֶם֙ דֶּ֣רֶךְ הַיַּרְדֵּ֔ן עַ֖ל הַֽמַּעְבְּר֑וֹת וְהַשַּׁ֣עַר סָגָ֔רוּ אַחֲרֵ֕י כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר יָצְא֥וּ הָרֹדְפִ֖ים אַחֲרֵיהֶֽם׃

passages.text: Before the spies lay down for the night, Rahab went up on the roof and said to them, “I know that the LORD has given you this land and that the fear of you has fallen on us, so that all who dwell in the land are melting in fear of you.
passages.sermon:
Rahab was a woman in Jericho.
She had hidden the Israelite spies on her roof.
Before the spies lay down for the night, Rahab went up to them on the roof.
She spoke to the men.
She said, “I know the LORD has given you this land.
The LORD is the God of Israel.
Fear of you has fallen on us.
All the people who live in this land are melting in fear because of you.”
passages.original: וְהֵ֖מָּה טֶ֣רֶם יִשְׁכָּב֑וּן וְהִ֛יא עָלְתָ֥ה עֲלֵיהֶ֖ם עַל־ הַגָּֽג׃ וַתֹּ֙אמֶר֙ אֶל־ הָ֣אֲנָשִׁ֔ים יָדַ֕עְתִּי כִּֽי־ נָתַ֧ן יְהוָ֛ה לָכֶ֖ם אֶת־ הָאָ֑רֶץ וְכִֽי־ נָפְלָ֤ה אֵֽימַתְכֶם֙ עָלֵ֔ינוּ וְכִ֥י נָמֹ֛גוּ כָּל־ יֹשְׁבֵ֥י הָאָ֖רֶץ מִפְּנֵיכֶֽם׃

passages.text: For we have heard how the LORD dried up the waters of the Red Sea before you when you came out of Egypt, and what you did to Sihon and Og, the two kings of the Amorites across the Jordan, whom you devoted to destruction.
passages.sermon:
Rahab spoke to the Israelite spies.
Rahab lived in Jericho.
Rahab said, “We have heard what the LORD did for you.”
The LORD dried up the waters of the Red Sea for you.
This happened when you came out of Egypt.
We also heard what you did to Sihon and Og.
Sihon and Og were kings of the Amorites.
They lived across the Jordan River.
You destroyed Sihon and Og completely.
passages.original: כִּ֣י שָׁמַ֗עְנוּ אֵ֠ת אֲשֶׁר־ הוֹבִ֨ישׁ יְהוָ֜ה אֶת־ מֵ֤י יַם־ סוּף֙ מִפְּנֵיכֶ֔ם בְּצֵאתְכֶ֖ם מִמִּצְרָ֑יִם וַאֲשֶׁ֣ר עֲשִׂיתֶ֡ם לִשְׁנֵי֩ מַלְכֵ֨י הָאֱמֹרִ֜י אֲשֶׁ֨ר בְּעֵ֤בֶר הַיַּרְדֵּן֙ לְסִיחֹ֣ן וּלְע֔וֹג אֲשֶׁ֥ר הֶחֱרַמְתֶּ֖ם אוֹתָֽם׃

passages.text: When we heard this, our hearts melted and everyone’s courage failed because of you, for the LORD your God is God in the heavens above and on the earth below.
passages.sermon:
Rahab spoke to the Israelite spies.
Rahab lived in Jericho.
Rahab said, “We heard what happened.”
Our hearts melted with fear.
No one had any courage left because of you.
The LORD is your God.
The LORD is God in heaven above.
The LORD is also God on the earth below.
passages.original: וַנִּשְׁמַע֙ וַיִּמַּ֣ס לְבָבֵ֔נוּ וְלֹא־ קָ֨מָה ע֥וֹד ר֛וּחַ בְּאִ֖ישׁ מִפְּנֵיכֶ֑ם כִּ֚י יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹֽהֵיכֶ֔ם ה֤וּא אֱלֹהִים֙ בַּשָּׁמַ֣יִם מִמַּ֔עַל וְעַל־ הָאָ֖רֶץ מִתָּֽחַת׃

passages.text: Now therefore, please swear to me by the LORD that you will indeed show kindness to my family, because I showed kindness to you. Give me a sure sign that you will spare the lives of my father and mother, my brothers and sisters, and all who belong to them, and that you will deliver us from death.”
passages.sermon:
Rahab spoke to the Israelite spies.
Rahab had hidden the spies in her house.
Rahab had shown kindness to them.
Rahab said, “Now, please swear to me by the LORD.”
She asked them to promise her something.
She said, “Because I showed kindness to you, show kindness to my family.”
She asked them to show kindness to her father’s house.
She said, “Give me a sure sign.”
She wanted proof of their promise.
She said, “Spare the lives of my father and my mother.”
She said, “Spare my brothers and my sisters.”
She said, “Spare all who belong to them.”
She said, “Save us from death.”
passages.original: וְעַתָּ֗ה הִשָּֽׁבְעוּ־ נָ֥א לִי֙ בַּֽיהוָ֔ה כִּי־ עָשִׂ֥יתִי עִמָּכֶ֖ם חָ֑סֶד וַעֲשִׂיתֶ֨ם גַּם־ אַתֶּ֜ם עִם־ בֵּ֤ית אָבִי֙ חֶ֔סֶד וּנְתַתֶּ֥ם לִ֖י א֥וֹת אֱמֶֽת׃ וְהַחֲיִתֶ֞ם אֶת־ אָבִ֣י וְאֶת־ אִמִּ֗י וְאֶת־ אַחַי֙ וְאֶת־ אַחוֹתַי וְאֵ֖ת כָּל־ אֲשֶׁ֣ר לָהֶ֑ם וְהִצַּלְתֶּ֥ם אֶת־ נַפְשֹׁתֵ֖ינוּ מִמָּֽוֶת׃

passages.text: “Our lives for your lives!” the men agreed. “If you do not report our mission, we will show you kindness and faithfulness when the LORD gives us the land.”
passages.sermon:
The men spoke to Rahab.
They said, “We will give our lives to save you.
This will happen if you do not tell anyone about our mission.
When the LORD gives us this land,
we will show you kindness.
We will be faithful to you.”
passages.original: וַיֹּ֧אמְרוּ לָ֣הּ הָאֲנָשִׁ֗ים נַפְשֵׁ֤נוּ תַחְתֵּיכֶם֙ לָמ֔וּת אִ֚ם לֹ֣א תַגִּ֔ידוּ אֶת־ דְּבָרֵ֖נוּ זֶ֑ה וְהָיָ֗ה בְּתֵת־ יְהוָ֥ה לָ֙נוּ֙ אֶת־ הָאָ֔רֶץ וְעָשִׂ֥ינוּ עִמָּ֖ךְ חֶ֥סֶד וֶאֱמֶֽת׃

passages.text: Then Rahab let them down by a rope through the window, since the house where she lived was built into the wall of the city.
passages.sermon:
Rahab was a woman who lived in Jericho.
She lived in a house built into the city wall.
Rahab helped the Israelite spies escape.
She let them down by a rope through her window.
passages.original: וַתּוֹרִדֵ֥ם בַּחֶ֖בֶל בְּעַ֣ד הַֽחַלּ֑וֹן כִּ֤י בֵיתָהּ֙ בְּקִ֣יר הַֽחוֹמָ֔ה וּבַֽחוֹמָ֖ה הִ֥יא יוֹשָֽׁבֶת׃

passages.text: “Go to the hill country,” she said, “so that your pursuers will not find you. Hide yourselves there for three days until they have returned; then go on your way.”
passages.sermon:
Rahab spoke to the two Israelite spies.
She said, "Go to the hill country."
She warned them about the men who were chasing them.
She said, "If you go to the hills, the pursuers will not find you."
She told them to hide in the hills for three days.
She said, "Wait there until the pursuers return."
She said, "After that, you can go on your way."
passages.original: וַתֹּ֤אמֶר לָהֶם֙ הָהָ֣רָה לֵּ֔כוּ פֶּֽן־ יִפְגְּע֥וּ בָכֶ֖ם הָרֹדְפִ֑ים וְנַחְבֵּתֶ֨ם שָׁ֜מָּה שְׁלֹ֣שֶׁת יָמִ֗ים עַ֚ד שׁ֣וֹב הָרֹֽדְפִ֔ים וְאַחַ֖ר תֵּלְכ֥וּ לְדַרְכְּכֶֽם׃

passages.text: The men said to her, “We will not be bound by this oath you made us swear unless, when we enter the land, you have tied this scarlet cord in the window through which you let us down, and unless you have brought your father and mother and brothers and all your family into your house.
passages.sermon:
Two Israelite men spoke to Rahab.
Rahab had hidden them in her house.
Rahab’s house was built into the city wall.
The men said, “We will not be responsible for this oath you made us swear unless you do certain things.”
They said, “We are coming into the land.”
They said, “You must tie this scarlet cord in the window.”
This was the window where you let us down by a rope.
You must also gather your father into your house.
You must gather your mother into your house.
You must gather your brothers into your house.
You must gather all your father’s family into your house.
All your family must be inside your house with you.
passages.original: וַיֹּאמְר֥וּ אֵלֶ֖יהָ הָאֲנָשִׁ֑ים נְקִיִּ֣ם אֲנַ֔חְנוּ מִשְּׁבֻעָתֵ֥ךְ הַזֶּ֖ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר הִשְׁבַּעְתָּֽנוּ׃ הִנֵּ֛ה אֲנַ֥חְנוּ בָאִ֖ים בָּאָ֑רֶץ אֶת־ תִּקְוַ֡ת חוּט֩ הַשָּׁנִ֨י הַזֶּ֜ה תִּקְשְׁרִ֗י בַּֽחַלּוֹן֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר הוֹרַדְתֵּ֣נוּ ב֔וֹ וְאֶת־ אָבִ֨יךְ וְאֶת־ אִמֵּ֜ךְ וְאֶת־ אַחַ֗יִךְ וְאֵת֙ כָּל־ בֵּ֣ית אָבִ֔יךְ תַּאַסְפִ֥י אֵלַ֖יִךְ הַבָּֽיְתָה׃

passages.text: If anyone goes out the door of your house into the street, his blood will be on his own head, and we will be innocent. But if a hand is laid on anyone with you in the house, his blood will be on our heads.
passages.sermon:
The men spoke to Rahab.
They gave her clear instructions.
If anyone leaves your house and goes outside,
That person is responsible for his own life.
We are not guilty if harm comes to him outside.
But if anyone stays with you inside the house,
We are responsible for that person’s safety.
If someone harms anyone inside your house,
We will be guilty for that person’s blood.
passages.original: וְהָיָ֡ה כֹּ֣ל אֲשֶׁר־ יֵצֵא֩ מִדַּלְתֵ֨י בֵיתֵ֧ךְ׀ הַח֛וּצָה דָּמ֥וֹ בְרֹאשׁ֖וֹ וַאֲנַ֣חְנוּ נְקִיִּ֑ם וְ֠כֹל אֲשֶׁ֨ר יִֽהְיֶ֤ה אִתָּךְ֙ בַּבַּ֔יִת דָּמ֣וֹ בְרֹאשֵׁ֔נוּ אִם־ יָ֖ד תִּֽהְיֶה־ בּֽוֹ׃

passages.text: And if you report our mission, we will be released from the oath you made us swear.”
passages.sermon:
The men spoke to Rahab.
They said, "If you tell anyone about our mission, we will not be bound by the oath you made us swear."
If you reveal our purpose, we are free from your oath.
passages.original: וְאִם־ תַּגִּ֖ידִי אֶת־ דְּבָרֵ֣נוּ זֶ֑ה וְהָיִ֣ינוּ נְקִיִּ֔ם מִשְּׁבֻעָתֵ֖ךְ אֲשֶׁ֥ר הִשְׁבַּעְתָּֽנוּ׃

passages.text: “Let it be as you say,” she replied, and she sent them away. And when they had gone, she tied the scarlet cord in the window.
passages.sermon:
Rahab was a woman in Jericho.
She spoke to the two Israelite spies.
She said, "Let it be as you say."
She agreed to their terms.
She sent the spies away from her house.
The spies left.
After they left, Rahab tied a scarlet cord in her window.
passages.original: וַתֹּ֙אמֶר֙ כְּדִבְרֵיכֶ֣ם כֶּן־ ה֔וּא וַֽתְּשַׁלְּחֵ֖ם וַיֵּלֵ֑כוּ וַתִּקְשֹׁ֛ר אֶת־ תִּקְוַ֥ת הַשָּׁנִ֖י בַּחַלּֽוֹן׃

passages.text: So the spies went out into the hill country and stayed there three days, until their pursuers had returned without finding them, having searched all along the road.
passages.sermon:
The spies were two men sent by Joshua to scout the land.
The spies left the city.
They went into the hill country.
They stayed there for three days.
Their pursuers searched for them.
The pursuers looked along every road.
The pursuers did not find the spies.
The pursuers returned after searching.
passages.original: וַיֵּלְכוּ֙ וַיָּבֹ֣אוּ הָהָ֔רָה וַיֵּ֤שְׁבוּ שָׁם֙ שְׁלֹ֣שֶׁת יָמִ֔ים עַד־ שָׁ֖בוּ הָרֹדְפִ֑ים וַיְבַקְשׁ֧וּ הָרֹדְפִ֛ים בְּכָל־ הַדֶּ֖רֶךְ וְלֹ֥א מָצָֽאוּ׃

passages.text: Then the two men started back, came down from the hill country, and crossed the river. So they came to Joshua son of Nun and reported all that had happened to them.
passages.sermon:
Two men had gone to spy in the land.
They returned from their mission.
They came down from the hill country.
They crossed the river.
They went to Joshua, the son of Nun.
They told Joshua everything that had happened to them.
passages.original: וַיָּשֻׁ֜בוּ שְׁנֵ֤י הָֽאֲנָשִׁים֙ וַיֵּרְד֣וּ מֵֽהָהָ֔ר וַיַּעַבְרוּ֙ וַיָּבֹ֔אוּ אֶל־ יְהוֹשֻׁ֖עַ בִּן־ נ֑וּן וַיְסַ֨פְּרוּ־ ל֔וֹ אֵ֥ת כָּל־ הַמֹּצְא֖וֹת אוֹתָֽם׃

passages.text: “The LORD has surely delivered the entire land into our hands,” they said to Joshua. “Indeed, all who dwell in the land are melting in fear of us.”
passages.sermon:
Two men spoke to Joshua.
Joshua was the leader of the Israelites.
The two men were spies sent by Joshua.
They said, “The LORD has given us the whole land.”
They said, “All the people living in the land are afraid of us.”
passages.original: וַיֹּאמְרוּ֙ אֶל־ יְהוֹשֻׁ֔עַ כִּֽי־ נָתַ֧ן יְהוָ֛ה בְּיָדֵ֖נוּ אֶת־ כָּל־ הָאָ֑רֶץ וְגַם־ נָמֹ֛גוּ כָּל־ יֹשְׁבֵ֥י הָאָ֖רֶץ מִפָּנֵֽינוּ׃ס
